# Adding 2016 data and creating table

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(knitr)

metadata_2016_raw <- read_csv("../data/2016metadata.csv")
dives_2016 <- metadata_2016_raw %>%
  filter(!is.na(Site) & !is.na(Date) & !is.na(Comments)) %>% #dropping NA fields
  # parsing dates to fix mdy formatting and formatting site names
  mutate(
    Date_clean = parse_date_time(Date, orders = c("mdy", "ymd", "dmy")),
    Site_clean = str_to_title(str_replace_all(Site, "'", "")),
    Comments_clean = str_trim(Comments), #remove whitespace
    #seperate year month and date 
    Year= year(Date_clean),
    Month_num = month(Date_clean),
    Month = month(Date_clean, label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE),   
    #make dive id for 2016 with date comments and site
    Dive_ID = paste(Site_clean, format(Date_clean, "%Y-%m-%d"), Comments_clean, sep = "_"))

dives_2016_distinct <- dives_2016 %>%
  # preventing replication of dives for each image
  distinct(Dive_ID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  select(Dive_ID, Site = Site_clean, Date_clean, Year, Month_num, Month) #select metadata to keep


# work on post 2018 metadata
metadata_post2018_raw <- read_csv("../data/metadata (2) cleaned with 20182022 added.csv")
dives_post2018 <- metadata_post2018_raw %>%
  filter(!is.na(Site) & !is.na(Date)) %>% # drop NA fields for site and date
  # parse date, clean site names and extract hour from dive start time
  mutate(
    Date_clean = parse_date_time(Date, orders = c("mdy", "ymd", "dmy")), #conver mdy to dmy
    Site_clean = str_to_title(str_replace_all(Site, "'", "")), # remove apostrophes
    Hour = str_extract(`Time (24hr)`, "^\\d+"), # extract the hour stopping at the semi colon ^ is start of text string \\ signifies digits and + one or more digits
    Hour = str_pad(Hour, width = 2, side = "left", pad = "0"), #add 0s to the first value
    #seperate year month and date
    Year= year(Date_clean),
    Month_num  = month(Date_clean),
    Month = month(Date_clean, label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE),
    # construct Dive_ID withs site date and hour
    Dive_ID    = paste(Site_clean, format(Date_clean, "%Y-%m-%d"), paste0("H", Hour), sep = "_"))


dives_post2018_distinct <- dives_post2018 %>%
  # remove duplication
  distinct(Dive_ID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  select(Dive_ID, Site = Site_clean, Date_clean, Year, Month_num, Month)#select necessary metadata


# append 2016 dives to post 2018 dives for a master dive metadata set
all_dives_metadata_distinct <- bind_rows(dives_2016_distinct, dives_post2018_distinct) %>%
  distinct(Dive_ID, .keep_all = TRUE)#with distinct entries

all_dives_metadata <- bind_rows(dives_2016, dives_post2018)#full metadata for all images

# #dive effort by year -erroneous
# table_all_year_site <- all_dives_metadata %>%
#   group_by(Year, Site) %>%
#   summarise(Total_Dives = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
#   pivot_wider(
#     names_from  = Site,
#     values_from = Total_Dives,
#     values_fill = 0
#   ) %>%
#   arrange(Year)

#dive effort by year
table_all_year_site <- all_dives_metadata %>%
  group_by(Year, Site) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_Dives  = n_distinct(Dive_ID), # this is the fix, counts unique dives
    # Total_Images = n(),
    .groups      = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from= Site,
    values_from = Total_Dives,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  arrange(Year)

table_all_years <- all_dives_metadata %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_Dives  = n_distinct(Dive_ID), # this is the fix, counts unique dives
    # Total_Images = n(),
    .groups      = "drop"
  ) %>%
 # pivot_wider(
 #   names_from= Site,
 #   values_from = Total_Dives,
 #   values_fill = 0
 # ) %>%
  arrange(Year)
#write_csv(table_all_year_site, "table_all_year_site.csv")

# #dive effort by year and month -erroneous
# table_all_year_month_site <- all_dives_metadata %>%
#   group_by(Year, Month, Site) %>%
#   summarise(Total_Dives = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
#   arrange(Year, Month) %>%
#   pivot_wider(
#     names_from  = Site,
#     values_from = Total_Dives,
#     values_fill = 0
#   )

#dive effort by year and month
table_all_year_month_site <- all_dives_metadata %>%
  group_by(Year, Month, Site) %>%
  summarise(Total_Dives = n_distinct(Dive_ID), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(Year, Month) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = Site,
    values_from = Total_Dives,
    values_fill = 0
  )
```

# Re-attempting data wrangling based on previous meeting.

major changes made:

split substrate category into sand rock, clamshell and rubble

excluding obscured categories to recalculate/ rescale percentage cover

selection of better sampling years will be conducted once more data is added

```{r}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 8
#| out-width: "100%"
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)

percent_covers_raw <- read_csv("../data/percent_covers(with20162022noALLIMAGESstats)v2.csv")
# vectors listing all individual species/genera for each category from columns in the dataset
hc_cols <- c("Acanthastrea", "Acropora", "Alveopora", "Coscinaraea", "Cynarina", 
             "Dipsastraea", "Echinophyllia", "Echinopora", "Favia", "Favites", 
             "Fungia", "Galaxea", "Goniastrea", "Goniopora", "Hard coral", 
             "Heteropsammia", "Leptoria", "Leptoseris incrustans", "Montastraea", 
             "Montipora", "Pavona", "Platygyra", "Pocillopora", "Porites", 
             "Psammocora", "Scolymia", "Stylophora", "Tubastrea", 
             "Turbinaria (coral)", "Millepora")

sc_cols <- c("Cladiella", "Dendronephthya", "Leptogorgia virgulata", "Lobophytum", 
             "Nephthya", "Sarcophyton", "Sclerophytum", "Soft Coral")

# algae_cols <- c("CCA (crustose coralline algae)", "Ceramium sp.", 
#                 "Halimeda", "Hypnea pannosa", "Jania", "Jania rubens", 
#                 "Lobophora", "Macroalgae", "Padina", "Turf algae", "Ulva", "Valonia spp.")

turfalgae_cols <- c("Ceramium sp.", "Jania", "Jania rubens","Turf algae")

macroalgae_cols <- c( "Halimeda", "Hypnea pannosa", 
                     "Lobophora", "Macroalga", "Padina", "Ulva", "Valonia spp.")

cca_cols <- c("CCA (crustose coralline algae)")

sponge_cols <- c("Cliona", "haliclona sp", "Ircinia sp.", "Sponge")

bleached_hc_cols <- c("Dead coral")
bleached_sc_cols <- c("Sclerophytum - bleached")
bleached_algae_cols <- c("bleached cca")

# new substrate columns
sand_cols <- c("Sand")
rock_cols<- c("Rock")
rubble_cols <- c("Rubble")
clam_shell_cols <- c("Clam Shell")

seagrass_cols  <- c("Seagrass")
other_invert_cols <- c("Anemone", "Ascidian", "Echinoderms", "Hydroid", 
                       "Nudibranch sp. - Egg Case Ribbon", "Nudibranch, unidentified", "Tridacna: Giant clam", "Zoanthid")

obscured_cols <- c("Tape_TWS", "Shadow")

#categorisation/ summing the genera within each category creating new columns within the dataframe with mutate
percent_covers_categorized <- percent_covers_raw %>%
  mutate(
    `Hard Coral` = rowSums(across(any_of(hc_cols)), na.rm = TRUE),
    `Soft Coral` = rowSums(across(any_of(sc_cols)), na.rm = TRUE),
    `Turf Algae` = rowSums(across(any_of(turfalgae_cols)), na.rm = TRUE),
    `Macroalgae` = rowSums(across(any_of(macroalgae_cols)), na.rm = TRUE),
    `Crustose Coralline Algae` = rowSums(across(any_of(cca_cols)), na.rm = TRUE),
    `Sponge` = rowSums(across(any_of(sponge_cols)), na.rm = TRUE),
    `Bleached Hard Coral` = rowSums(across(any_of(bleached_hc_cols)), na.rm = TRUE),
    `Bleached Soft Coral` = rowSums(across(any_of(bleached_sc_cols)), na.rm = TRUE),
    `Bleached Algae` = rowSums(across(any_of(bleached_algae_cols)), na.rm = TRUE),
    `Sand` = rowSums(across(any_of(sand_cols)), na.rm = TRUE),
    `Rock` = rowSums(across(any_of(rock_cols)), na.rm = TRUE),
    `Rubble` = rowSums(across(any_of(rubble_cols)), na.rm = TRUE),
    `Shell Fragments` = rowSums(across(any_of(clam_shell_cols)), na.rm = TRUE),
    
    `Seagrass` = rowSums(across(any_of(seagrass_cols)), na.rm = TRUE),
    `Other Invertebrates` = rowSums(across(any_of(other_invert_cols)), na.rm = TRUE),
    #total obscured cover
    obscured_raw = rowSums(across(any_of(obscured_cols)), na.rm = TRUE),
    # Normalization multiplier to scale remaining cover to 100% after removing obscured cover
    norm_mult = if_else(obscured_raw < 100, 100 / (100 - obscured_raw), 1)
  ) %>%
  # Apply normalization to valid categories
  mutate(across(
    c(`Hard Coral`, `Soft Coral`, `Turf Algae`, `Macroalgae`, `Crustose Coralline Algae`, `Sponge`,
      `Bleached Hard Coral`, `Bleached Soft Coral`, `Bleached Algae`,
      `Sand`, `Rock`, `Rubble`, `Shell Fragments`, `Seagrass`, `Other Invertebrates`), ~ .x * norm_mult))

#joiun with the metadata while excluding the 2018 years in the join
joined_cover_data <- percent_covers_categorized %>%
  inner_join(all_dives_metadata, by = c("Image name" = "Name")) %>%# inner join percent covers with metadata using filenames for jpgs
  filter(Year != 2018, Year != 2026, Year != 2024) #excludes 2018 images because cover hasnt been calculated for them

#create a variable for all the target categories
all_categories <- c(
  "Hard Coral", "Soft Coral", "Turf Algae", "Macroalgae", "Crustose Coralline Algae", "Sponge", 
  "Bleached Hard Coral", "Bleached Soft Coral", "Bleached Algae", 
  "Sand", "Rock", "Rubble", "Shell Fragments",
  "Seagrass", "Other Invertebrates"
)

core_sites <- c("Batfish", "Caves", "Devils Peak", "Pao") ##commented out as sites have been collapsed on years
#create a summary data frame using pivot longer moving categories to rows (filtered to core sites)
site_year_summary <- joined_cover_data %>% filter(Site_clean %in% core_sites) %>% ## commented out as we arent narrowing replicates to core sites anymore
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(all_categories),
    names_to = "Category",
    values_to = "Cover"
  ) %>%
  #group_by(Dive_ID, Site_clean, Year, Category) %>%# group by transect/dive
  group_by(Dive_ID, Year, Category) %>%# group by transect/dive
  summarise(transect_cover = mean(Cover, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Year, Category) %>%
  #group_by(Site_clean, Year, Category) %>%
  summarise(#summary statistics
    n_dives = n_distinct(Dive_ID),
    mean_cover = mean(transect_cover, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_cover = sd(transect_cover, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n_dives),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

#lineplot 1
target_groups <- c("Hard Coral", "Soft Coral", "Turf Algae", "Macroalgae", "Crustose Coralline Algae", "Sponge")
core_sites <- c("Batfish", "Caves", "Devils Peak", "Pao")

focused_summary <- site_year_summary %>%
  filter(
    Category %in% target_groups,
    #Site_clean %in% core_sites,

ggplot(focused_summary, aes(x = factor(Year), y = mean_cover, color = Category, group = Category)) +
```

```{r}
  facet_wrap(~ Category, scales = "free_y") +  # Facet by functional group with independent y-axes
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  labs(
    title = "Yearly Cover Trends by Benthic Functional Group",
    x = "Survey Year",
    y = "Mean Substrate Cover (%)"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none",  # Removes redundant color legend since facets label categories
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```

# NOAA Coral Watch Data Visualisation

# 

**shift focus to algae, do any modelling with sites as a random effect**

ADD MAXIMUM MONTHLY MEANS TO DHW PLOT AS LINE PARALLEL TO X AXIS

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 4
#| out-width: "100%"
library(RColorBrewer)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)

# load data
sstdata <- read.csv("../data/DHWGUINJATA2006.csv", strip.white = TRUE, header = TRUE)

# use mutate to edit time field to a posixct value
head(sstdata)
sstdata <- sstdata %>% #converts time field to a posixct value
  mutate(time = ymd_hms(time)#convertrs time field to a posixct value
         #,time = date(time) converting posixct to date only (uneccessary for this)
  ) %>%
  filter(time >= as.Date("2010-01-01")) #edit this to edit where timescale starts
head(sstdata)
# plot SST line colored by DHW values
sst_plot <- ggplot(sstdata, aes(x = time, y = CRW_SST)) +
  geom_col(aes(color=CRW_DHW),  show.legend=T) + #plots geom cols overlay
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 27.78, 
    linetype = "dashed", 
    color = "red", 
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text", 
    x = as.Date("2024-06-01"), 
    y = 30.2, 
    label = "MMM = 27.78°C", 
    color = "red", 
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  ##comment out from here##
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 28.78, 
    #linetype = "dashed", 
    color = "violet", 
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text", 
    x = as.Date("2013-06-01"), 
    y = 30.2, 
    label = "Bleaching Threshold = 28.78°C", 
    color = "violet", 
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  ##comment out from here##
  scale_color_gradientn(
    "Degree Heating Weeks (°C-weeks)",
    colors = rev(brewer.pal(10, "RdYlBu"))# reverses the color gradient, picks the number of distinct shades and color palette
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous("Sea Surface Temperature (°C)") +
  scale_x_date(
    "Years",
    breaks = seq(as.Date("2006-01-01"), as.Date("2026-01-01"), by = "1 year"), # sets one year breaks on the x axis
    date_labels = "%Y", #labels x axis on year alone
    expand = c(0, 0)
  )+ labs(#title = "Sea Surface Temperatures and Heat Stress Events at Jangamo Bay (2010-2025)",
    x = "Year" ) + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

Cyclones in jangamo (track intersect)

```{r}
library(lubridate)
library(sf)
library(tidyverse)

# read header first to get column names and then skip metadata row (row 2)
raw_data <- read_csv("../data/ibtracs.ALL.list.v04r00.csv", skip = 2, col_names = FALSE, show_col_types = FALSE)
header <- read_csv("../data/ibtracs.ALL.list.v04r00.csv", n_max = 1, show_col_types = FALSE)
colnames(raw_data) <- colnames(header)

# clean and filter data
ibtracs_clean <- raw_data %>%
  # parse date and filter from 2006-2025
  mutate(ISO_TIME = ymd_hms(ISO_TIME),
         YEAR = year(ISO_TIME)) %>%
  filter(YEAR >= 2010 & YEAR <= 2025) %>%
  #geographic coordinates to numeric conversion
  mutate(LAT = as.numeric(LAT),
         LON = as.numeric(LON),
         USA_WIND = as.numeric(USA_WIND)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(LAT) & !is.na(LON))

# bounding box for guinjata bay constructed
# Jangamo center is approx Lat: -24.11, Lon: 35.31
# Bounding Box covering Jangamo district & immediate offshore waters:
#jangamo_bbox <- st_bbox(c(xmin = 35.1, xmax = 35.7, ymin = -24.4, ymax = -23.8), crs = st_crs(4326))

##bounding box guinjata specifically
#jangamo_bbox <- st_bbox(c(xmin = 35.45, xmax = 35.54, ymin = -24.11, ymax = -24.03), crs = st_crs(4326))
jangamo_bbox <- st_bbox(c(xmin = 35.453610788027646, xmax = 35.54661079375808, ymin = -24.08297066008683, ymax = -24.042865383716418), crs = st_crs(4326))
#convert IBTrACS points into sf spatial object
ibtracs_sf <- st_as_sf(ibtracs_clean, coords = c("LON", "LAT"), crs = 4326)

#create a 150 km buffer around Jangamo to capture track points impacting region
jangamo_poly <- st_as_sfc(jangamo_bbox)
jangamo_buffer <- st_buffer(st_transform(jangamo_poly, 32736), dist = 100000) %>% 
  st_transform(4326)

# spatial intersection
impact_points <- st_intersection(ibtracs_sf, jangamo_buffer)

# summarize unique cyclones
jangamo_cyclones <- impact_points %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(SID, NAME, YEAR) %>%
  summarise(
    First_Impact = min(ISO_TIME),
    Last_Impact = max(ISO_TIME),
    Max_Wind_Kts = max(USA_WIND, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(First_Impact)

print(jangamo_cyclones)
```

cyclones in jangamo (wind radii intersect) (need previous block of code to work)

```{r}
library(ggrepel)
library(tidyverse)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(rnaturalearthdata)
library(sf)

# 1. Base spatial setup & bounding box pre-filter
world <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")

# Extract coordinates directly from sf geometry to avoid missing column errors
coords_all <- st_coordinates(ibtracs_sf)

# Filter raw points geographically first using spatial coordinates
# (This drops 95%+ of global tracks instantly without needing LAT/LON columns)
regional_mask <- coords_all[, 2] >= -30 & coords_all[, 2] <= -18 &
  coords_all[, 1] >= 30  & coords_all[, 1] <= 42

ibtracs_regional <- ibtracs_sf[regional_mask, ]

# Convert regional points to UTM Zone 36S (meters)
ibtracs_utm <- st_transform(ibtracs_regional, 32736)

# Extract 34-knot wind radii (Nautical Miles to Meters: 1 NM = 1852 m)
ibtracs_utm <- ibtracs_utm %>%
  mutate(
    R34_NE = coalesce(as.numeric(USA_R34_NE) * 1852, 50000),
    R34_SE = coalesce(as.numeric(USA_R34_SE) * 1852, 50000),
    R34_SW = coalesce(as.numeric(USA_R34_SW) * 1852, 50000),
    R34_NW = coalesce(as.numeric(USA_R34_NW) * 1852, 50000)
  )

# Replace 0 values with 50km default fallback
ibtracs_utm <- ibtracs_utm %>%
  mutate(across(c(R34_NE, R34_SE, R34_SW, R34_NW), ~ if_else(.x == 0, 50000, .x)))

# 2. Vectorized 4-quadrant wind polygon generator
coords_mat <- st_coordinates(ibtracs_utm)

wind_geoms <- pmap(
  list(coords_mat[, 1], coords_mat[, 2], 
       ibtracs_utm$R34_NE, ibtracs_utm$R34_SE, 
       ibtracs_utm$R34_SW, ibtracs_utm$R34_NW),
  function(cx, cy, ne, se, sw, nw) {
    angles_ne <- seq(0, pi/2, length.out = 8)
    angles_nw <- seq(pi/2, pi, length.out = 8)
    angles_sw <- seq(pi, 3*pi/2, length.out = 8)
    angles_se <- seq(3*pi/2, 2*pi, length.out = 8)
    
    poly_coords <- rbind(
      cbind(cx + ne * cos(angles_ne), cy + ne * sin(angles_ne)),
      cbind(cx + nw * cos(angles_nw), cy + nw * sin(angles_nw)),
      cbind(cx + sw * cos(angles_sw), cy + sw * sin(angles_sw)),
      cbind(cx + se * cos(angles_se), cy + se * sin(angles_se))
    )
    poly_coords <- rbind(poly_coords, poly_coords[1, ])
    st_polygon(list(poly_coords))
  }
)

# Assign wind polygons as active spatial geometries
ibtracs_wind_sf <- ibtracs_utm
ibtracs_wind_sf$geometry <- st_sfc(wind_geoms, crs = 32736)

# 3. Transform jangamo_buffer to match UTM projection
jangamo_buffer_utm <- st_transform(jangamo_buffer, 32736)

# 4. Filter cyclones by checking if WIND RADII intersect the Jangamo buffer
impact_sids <- ibtracs_wind_sf %>%
  filter(st_intersects(geometry, jangamo_buffer_utm, sparse = FALSE)[, 1]) %>%
  pull(SID) %>%
  unique()


# 5. Extract FULL track points (WGS84) for storms identified via wind radii intersection
impact_tracks_sf <- ibtracs_sf %>%
  filter(SID %in% impact_sids) %>%
  arrange(SID, ISO_TIME)

# Summarize unique cyclones and their impact duration & max wind
jangamo_cyclones_summary <- impact_tracks_sf %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  mutate(USA_WIND = as.numeric(USA_WIND)) %>%
  group_by(SID, NAME, YEAR) %>%
  summarise(
    First_Impact = min(ISO_TIME),
    Last_Impact = max(ISO_TIME),
    Max_Wind_Kts = max(USA_WIND, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(First_Impact)
# Convert track points into continuous lines for each identified cyclone
jangamo_cyclones <- impact_tracks_sf %>%
  group_by(SID, NAME, YEAR) %>%
  summarise(do_union = FALSE, .groups = "drop") %>%
  st_cast("LINESTRING")
```

track plot with radii FACETED

```{r}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 7
#| out-width: "100%"
library(ggrepel)
library(tidyverse)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(rnaturalearthdata)
library(sf)

# 1. Base Map Setup
world <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")

# Extract unique storm IDs
impact_sids <- jangamo_cyclones$SID

# 2. Filter tracks, convert R34 radii (NM to meters), and set chronological levels
tracks_with_radii <- ibtracs_sf %>%
  filter(SID %in% impact_sids) %>%
  mutate(
    Pressure_hPa = as.numeric(USA_PRES),
    R34_NE = coalesce(as.numeric(USA_R34_NE) * 1852, 50000),
    R34_SE = coalesce(as.numeric(USA_R34_SE) * 1852, 50000),
    R34_SW = coalesce(as.numeric(USA_R34_SW) * 1852, 50000),
    R34_NW = coalesce(as.numeric(USA_R34_NW) * 1852, 50000),
    NAME_YEAR = paste0(NAME, " (", YEAR, ")")
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(c(R34_NE, R34_SE, R34_SW, R34_NW), ~ if_else(.x == 0, 50000, .x))) %>%
  arrange(ISO_TIME)

# Order NAME_YEAR factor levels chronologically based on first occurrence
ordered_labels <- tracks_with_radii %>%
  group_by(NAME_YEAR) %>%
  summarise(first_time = min(ISO_TIME), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(first_time) %>%
  pull(NAME_YEAR)

tracks_with_radii <- tracks_with_radii %>%
  mutate(NAME_YEAR = factor(NAME_YEAR, levels = ordered_labels))

# Project points to UTM zone 36S (meters) to construct spatial geometry for swaths
tracks_utm <- st_transform(tracks_with_radii, 32736)

# 3. Vectorized 4-quadrant wind polygon generator
coords_mat <- st_coordinates(tracks_utm)

wind_geoms <- pmap(
  list(coords_mat[, 1], coords_mat[, 2], 
       tracks_utm$R34_NE, tracks_utm$R34_SE, 
       tracks_utm$R34_SW, tracks_utm$R34_NW),
  function(cx, cy, ne, se, sw, nw) {
    angles_ne <- seq(0, pi/2, length.out = 8)
    angles_nw <- seq(pi/2, pi, length.out = 8)
    angles_sw <- seq(pi, 3*pi/2, length.out = 8)
    angles_se <- seq(3*pi/2, 2*pi, length.out = 8)
    
    poly_coords <- rbind(
      cbind(cx + ne * cos(angles_ne), cy + ne * sin(angles_ne)),
      cbind(cx + nw * cos(angles_nw), cy + nw * sin(angles_nw)),
      cbind(cx + sw * cos(angles_sw), cy + sw * sin(angles_sw)),
      cbind(cx + se * cos(angles_se), cy + se * sin(angles_se))
    )
    poly_coords <- rbind(poly_coords, poly_coords[1, ])
    st_polygon(list(poly_coords))
  }
)

# Assign wind polygons as active spatial geometries
tracks_utm$geometry_poly <- st_sfc(wind_geoms, crs = 32736)

# 4. Merge individual observation shapes into storm impact swaths per cyclone
swaths_sf <- tracks_utm %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  st_set_geometry("geometry_poly") %>%
  group_by(SID, NAME, YEAR, NAME_YEAR) %>%
  summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry_poly), .groups = "drop") %>%
  st_transform(4326) # Transform back to standard WGS84 coordinates

# 5. Build full 2-point line segments across ALL track points
segments_all <- tracks_with_radii %>%
  group_by(SID, NAME_YEAR) %>%
  mutate(next_geom = lead(geometry)) %>%
  filter(!st_is_empty(next_geom)) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    geometry = st_sfc(st_linestring(rbind(st_coordinates(geometry), 
                                          st_coordinates(next_geom))), 
                      crs = 4326)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  st_as_sf()

# Define map framing box
map_bounds <- st_bbox(c(xmin = 32.0, xmax = 40.0, ymin = -27.0, ymax = -20.0), crs = st_crs(4326))

# Add Jangamo / Guinjata Bay point location
jangamo_point <- st_sf(
  name = "Guinjata Bay",
  geometry = st_sfc(st_point(c(35.495697967176504, -24.071923288725014)), crs = 4326)
)

# 6. Plot Faceted Tracks Chronologically
ggplot() +
  # Draw base map
  geom_sf(data = world, fill = "#e0e0e0", color = "#ffffff", linewidth = 0.3) +
  
  # Draw Jangamo Target Zone
  geom_sf(data = jangamo_buffer, fill = "gold", alpha = 0.3, color = "darkorange", linetype = "solid") +
  
  # Layer 1: Draw Wind Swath Polygons (Shaded Impact Zones)
  geom_sf(data = swaths_sf, fill = "#3182bd", alpha = 0.25, color = NA) +
  
  # Layer 2a: Underlying baseline for COMPLETE cyclone track paths (grey line)
  geom_sf(data = segments_all, color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.8) +
  
  # Layer 2b: Overlay track segments colored by central pressure where available
  geom_sf(data = filter(segments_all, !is.na(Pressure_hPa)), aes(color = Pressure_hPa), linewidth = 1.3) +
  
  # Layer 3: Draw 3-hour Center Point Locations (colored where pressure is present)
  geom_sf(data = filter(tracks_with_radii, !is.na(Pressure_hPa)), aes(color = Pressure_hPa), size = 1, alpha = 0.8) +
  
  # Add Jangamo point location marker
  geom_sf(data = jangamo_point, color = "black", fill = "red", shape = 21, size = 2.5, stroke = 0.8) +
  
  # Add Jangamo point label
  geom_text_repel(data = jangamo_point, 
                  aes(x = st_coordinates(geometry)[,1], 
                      y = st_coordinates(geometry)[,2], 
                      label = "Jangamo/Guinjata bay"),
                  color = "black", fontface = "bold", size = 2.8, 
                  nudge_x = 0.8, nudge_y = -0.3, box.padding = 0.3) +
  
  # Map Framing
  coord_sf(xlim = c(map_bounds["xmin"], map_bounds["xmax"]), 
           ylim = c(map_bounds["ymin"], map_bounds["ymax"]), 
           expand = FALSE) +
  
  # Facet chronologically by ordered NAME_YEAR factor
  facet_wrap(~ NAME_YEAR) +
  
  # Continuous inverted magma scale for Central Pressure
  scale_color_viridis_c(
    name = "Central Pressure\n(hPa)", 
    option = "magma", 
    direction = -1
  ) +
  
  # Styling & Themes
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    #title = "Storm Tracks & Gale Wind Impact Zones (2010–2025)",
    #subtitle = str_wrap("Track colored by central pressure | Grey baseline = track segments without pressure data | 100km site buffer zone in yellow"),
    x = "Longitude",
    y = "Latitude"
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#edf7ff"),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "white", linewidth = 0.2),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#e0e0e0", color = NA),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(0.9, "lines"),
    panel.spacing.y = unit(0.5, "lines"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```

```{r}
library(lubridate)
```

```{r}
# 1. Prepare benthic summary data (filtered >= 2016)
target_groups <- c("Hard Coral", "Soft Coral", "Turf Algae", "Macroalgae", "Crustose Coralline Algae", "Sponge", "Rock")

focused_summary_dateshift <- site_year_summary %>%
  filter(
    Category %in% target_groups,
    Year >= 2016 & Year <= 2025
  ) %>%
  mutate(Survey_Date = as.Date(paste0(Year, "-04-01")))

# 2. Filter disturbance data (filtered >= 2016)

  filter(First_Impact >= as.Date("2016-01-01")) %>%
  mutate(Type = "Cyclone")

  filter(First_Impact >= as.Date("2016-01-01"))

# 3. Plot with well-defined publication-ready axes and error bar caps

  geom_vline(data = cyclone_lines, aes(xintercept = First_Impact),

  geom_vline(data = mhw_data, aes(xintercept = First_Impact), 
             color = "#e31a1c", linewidth = 0.4, alpha = 0.8) +
  # Error bars with wider horizontal caps (width = 180 days / ~6 months)
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = pmax(0, mean_cover - se_cover), ymax = mean_cover + se_cover), 
                width = 180, linewidth = 0.6, alpha = 0.9) +
  # Trend lines and points on top
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  # Facet setup
  facet_wrap(~ Category, scales = "free_y") +
  # Restrict breaks to 2016, 2019, 2022, and 2025 with padding for edge caps
  scale_x_date(
    limits = c(as.Date("2015-09-01"), as.Date("2026-03-01")),
    breaks = as.Date(c("2016-01-01", "2019-01-01", "2022-01-01", "2025-01-01")),
    date_labels = "%Y",
    expand = c(0.01, 0.01)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, NA),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  labs(
    title = "Benthic Functional Group Cover with Disturbance Timelines (2016–2025)",

    y = "Mean Substrate Cover (%)"

  )
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. SETUP EXCLUSIONS AND CORE SITES

excluded_cols <- c(
  "Sand", "Rock", "Rubble", "Clam Shell", "Seagrass",

)

core_sites <- c("Batfish", "Caves", "Devils Peak", "Pao")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. PREPARE LONG-FORMAT BIOLOGICAL DATA
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
bio_data_long <- joined_cover_data %>%
  filter(!Year %in% c(2018, 2026), Site_clean %in% core_sites) %>%# remember to comment out site clean in core sites if not focusing core sites
  pivot_longer(
    cols = where(is.numeric) & !any_of(c("Year", "Month_num", "norm_mult", "obscured_raw", "Image ID", "Points", "Visibility (m)" )),
    names_to = "Taxon",
    values_to = "Cover"
  ) %>%
  filter(!Taxon %in% excluded_cols, !is.na(Cover), Cover > 0)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. BOX PLOT WITH JITTERED DIVES + MEAN DIAMONDS
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
dive_richness <- bio_data_long %>%
  #group_by(Dive_ID, Site_clean, Year) %>%
  group_by(Dive_ID, Year) %>%
  summarise(richness = n_distinct(Taxon), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(dive_richness, aes(x = factor(Year), y = richness)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +                      # Boxplot (shows median)
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.4, size = 1.2) +    # Individual dive points
  stat_summary(                                          # Plot MEAN as a diamond
    fun = mean, 
    geom = "point", 
    shape = 18,                                          # 18 = diamond (use shape = 4 for 'X')
    size = 3.5, 
    color = "red"
  ) +
  #facet_wrap(~ Site_clean) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Taxa Richness (Count / Dive)")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. PLOT 2: WHITTAKER (RANK-ABUNDANCE) CURVE BY SITE
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
whittaker_data <- bio_data_long %>%
  group_by(Taxon) %>%
  #group_by(Site_clean, Taxon) %>%
  summarise(mean_cover = mean(Cover, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop_last") %>%
  mutate(
    relative_abundance = mean_cover / sum(mean_cover),
    rank = min_rank(desc(relative_abundance))
  )

ggplot(whittaker_data, aes(x = rank, y = relative_abundance)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  scale_y_log10() #+
  #facet_wrap(~ Site_clean)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. PLOT 3: MEAN SPECIES RICHNESS LINE PLOT WITH SE
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
richness_summary <- dive_richness %>%
  #group_by(Site_clean, Year) %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  summarise(
    n_dives       = n_distinct(Dive_ID),
    mean_richness = mean(richness),
    se_richness   = sd(richness) / sqrt(n_dives),
    .groups       = "drop"
  )

#ggplot(richness_summary, aes(x = factor(Year), y = mean_richness, group = Site_clean)) +
ggplot(richness_summary, aes(x = factor(Year), y = mean_richness, group = 1)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_richness - se_richness, ymax = mean_richness + se_richness), width = 0.2) +
  #facet_wrap(~ Site_clean) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Mean Taxa Richness (±1 SE)")
```

rough pca

```{r}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 7
#| out-width: "100%"
library(tidyverse)
library(vegan)

# Filter out excluded years and isolate target sites
pca_data <- bio_data_long %>%
  filter(!Year %in% c(2018, 2026)) %>%
  filter(Site_clean %in% c("Batfish", "Caves", "Devils Peak", "Pao"))

# Pivot to wide format for vegan
pca_wide <- pca_data %>%
  group_by(Site_clean, Year, Taxon) %>%
  summarise(cover = mean(Cover, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Taxon, values_from = cover, values_fill = 0)

# Extract matrix and convert years to factor for plotting
site_info <- pca_wide %>% 
  select(Site_clean, Year) %>% 
  mutate(Year = factor(Year))

comm_matrix <- pca_wide %>% select(-Site_clean, -Year)

# Hellinger transformation & PCA
comm_hellinger <- decostand(comm_matrix, method = "hellinger")
pca_fit <- rda(comm_hellinger)

# Pull axis variance percentages
var_pc1 <- round(summary(pca_fit)$cont$importance[2, 1] * 100, 1)
var_pc2 <- round(summary(pca_fit)$cont$importance[2, 2] * 100, 1)

# Get site-year point scores
site_scores <- as.data.frame(scores(pca_fit, display = "sites")) %>%
  bind_cols(site_info)

# Get species vectors and select top drivers
species_scores <- as.data.frame(scores(pca_fit, display = "species")) %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "Taxon") %>%
  mutate(dist = sqrt(PC1^2 + PC2^2)) %>%
  slice_max(dist, n = 12)

# Plot ordination
ggplot() +
  geom_segment(data = species_scores, 
               aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = PC1, yend = PC2),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm")), 
               color = "grey30") +
  geom_text(data = species_scores, 
            aes(x = PC1 * 1.15, y = PC2 * 1.15, label = Taxon), 
            size = 3.5, fontface = "bold") +
  geom_point(data = site_scores, 
             aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Site_clean, shape = Year), 
             size = 3) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) +
  labs(
    title = "Genus/Taxa-Level PCA Ordination",
    subtitle = "Hellinger-transformed community matrix | Main target sites",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", var_pc1, "% Variance)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", var_pc2, "% Variance)"),
    color = "Site",
    shape = "Year"
  )
```

```{r}
  pivot_wider(names_from = Taxon, values_from = cover, values_fill = 0)

# Extract matrix and convert years to factor for plotting
site_info <- pca_wide %>% 
  select(Site_clean, Year) %>% 
  mutate(Year = factor(Year))

comm_matrix <- pca_wide %>% select(-Site_clean, -Year)

# Hellinger transformation & PCA
comm_hellinger <- decostand(comm_matrix, method = "hellinger")
pca_fit <- rda(comm_hellinger)

# Pull axis variance percentages
var_pc1 <- round(summary(pca_fit)$cont$importance[2, 1] * 100, 1)
var_pc2 <- round(summary(pca_fit)$cont$importance[2, 2] * 100, 1)

# Get site-year point scores
site_scores <- as.data.frame(scores(pca_fit, display = "sites")) %>%
  bind_cols(site_info)

# Get species vectors and select top drivers
species_scores <- as.data.frame(scores(pca_fit, display = "species")) %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "Taxon") %>%
  mutate(dist = sqrt(PC1^2 + PC2^2)) %>%
  slice_max(dist, n = 12)

# Plot ordination with years as colors and sites as shapes
ggplot() +
  # 95% confidence ellipses grouped and colored by Year
  stat_ellipse(data = site_scores, 
               aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Year, fill = Year),
               type = "t", level = 0.95, geom = "polygon", alpha = 0.15, linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_segment(data = species_scores, 
               aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = PC1, yend = PC2),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm")), 
               color = "grey30") +
  geom_text(data = species_scores, 
            aes(x = PC1 * 1.15, y = PC2 * 1.15, label = Taxon), 
            size = 3.5, fontface = "bold") +
  geom_point(data = site_scores, 
             aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, shape = Site_clean, color = Year), 
             size = 3) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) +
  labs(
    #title = "Genus/Taxa-Level PCA Plot for Jangamo and Guinjata Bay from 2016-2025",
    #subtitle = "Hellinger-transformed community matrix | 95% Year Confidence Ellipses",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", var_pc1, "% Variance)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", var_pc2, "% Variance)"),
    color = "Year",
    fill = "Year",
    shape = "Site"
  )
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# Filter out excluded years, isolate target sites

  mutate(Taxon = if_else(Taxon == "Ceramium sp.", "Turf algae", Taxon))

# Pivot to wide format for vegan (summing cover if both were present at the same site-year)
pca_wide <- pca_data %>%
  group_by(Site_clean, Year, Taxon) %>%
  summarise(cover = sum(Cover, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Taxon, values_from = cover, values_fill = 0)

# Extract matrix and convert years to factor for plotting
site_info <- pca_wide %>% 
  select(Site_clean, Year) %>% 
  mutate(Year = factor(Year))

comm_matrix <- pca_wide %>% select(-Site_clean, -Year)

# Hellinger transformation & PCA
comm_hellinger <- decostand(comm_matrix, method = "hellinger")
pca_fit <- rda(comm_hellinger)

# ==========================================
# EXTRACT & EXPORT APPENDIX TABLES (CSV)
# ==========================================

# 1. Eigenvalues and Variance Explained Summary Table
eigen_summary <- summary(pca_fit)$cont$importance
eigen_df <- as.data.frame(t(eigen_summary)) %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "Axis") %>%
  rename(
    Eigenvalue = 2,
    Proportion_Explained = 3,
    Cumulative_Proportion = 4
  )

# 2. Full Species Loading Scores (Eigenvectors) Table sorted by distance from origin
all_species_scores <- as.data.frame(scores(pca_fit, display = "species")) %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "Taxon") %>%
  mutate(Vector_Length = sqrt(PC1^2 + PC2^2)) %>%
  arrange(desc(Vector_Length))

# Export tables to CSV format in your working directory
write.csv(eigen_df, "pca_eigenvalues_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(all_species_scores, "pca_species_loading_scores.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Print confirmation to console
print("Appendix CSV files successfully exported: 'pca_eigenvalues_summary.csv' & 'pca_species_loading_scores.csv'")

# ==========================================
# PLOTTING PIPELINE
# ==========================================

# Pull axis variance percentages for plot labels
var_pc1 <- round(summary(pca_fit)$cont$importance[2, 1] * 100, 1)
var_pc2 <- round(summary(pca_fit)$cont$importance[2, 2] * 100, 1)

# Get site-year point scores
site_scores <- as.data.frame(scores(pca_fit, display = "sites")) %>%
  bind_cols(site_info)

# Get species vectors and select top drivers for the plot
species_scores <- as.data.frame(scores(pca_fit, display = "species")) %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "Taxon") %>%
  mutate(dist = sqrt(PC1^2 + PC2^2)) %>%
  slice_max(dist, n = 12)

# Plot ordination with years as colors and sites as shapes
ggplot() +
  # 95% confidence ellipses grouped and colored by Year
  stat_ellipse(data = site_scores, 
               aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Year, fill = Year),
               type = "t", level = 0.95, geom = "polygon", alpha = 0.15, linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_segment(data = species_scores, 
               aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = PC1, yend = PC2),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm")), 
               color = "grey30") +
  geom_text_repel(data = species_scores, 
                  aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, label = Taxon), 
                  size = 3.5, 
                  fontface = "bold",
                  box.padding = 0.4,
                  point.padding = 0.2,
                  max.overlaps = Inf) +
  geom_point(data = site_scores, 
             aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, shape = Site_clean, color = Year), 
             size = 3) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) +
  labs(
    x = paste0("PC1 (", var_pc1, "% Variance)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", var_pc2, "% Variance)"),
    color = "Year",
    fill = "Year",
    shape = "Site"
  )
```

WORKING BAYESIAN GLMM

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# 0. SETUP ENVIRONMENT & LIBRARIES
# =============================================================================

Sys.setenv(PATH = paste(
  "C:/RBuildTools/4.5/usr/bin",
  "C:/RBuildTools/4.5/x86_64-w64-mingw32.static.posix/bin",
  Sys.getenv("PATH"),
  sep = ";"
))

options(pkgbuild.has_build_tools = TRUE)

library(cmdstanr)
library(brms)
library(bayesplot)
library(tidybayes)
library(emmeans)
library(tidyverse)


# =============================================================================
# 1. PREPARE MODEL DATASET
# =============================================================================

target_years <- c(2016, 2019, 2022, 2025)

bayes_benthic_df <- joined_cover_data %>%
  filter(Year %in% target_years) %>%
  mutate(
    Year_fac = factor(Year),
    Site_fac = factor(Site_clean),
    Dive_fac = factor(Dive_ID)
  )


# =============================================================================
# 2. REUSABLE BAYESIAN GLMM FUNCTION
# =============================================================================

run_benthic_bayes_year_glmm <- function(data, 
                                        target_category, 
                                        family = zero_inflated_beta(),
                                        cores = 4,
                                        chains = 4,
                                        iter = 3000,
                                        warmup = 1000) {
  
  message(paste0(">>> Running Year-Based Bayesian GLMM for Category: ", target_category))
  
  df_sub <- data %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = all_of(all_categories),
      names_to = "Category",
      values_to = "Cover_Pct"
    ) %>%
    filter(Category == target_category) %>%
    group_by(Dive_ID, Site_clean, Year) %>%
    summarise(Cover_Pct = mean(Cover_Pct, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(
      Cover_Prop = Cover_Pct / 100,
      Year_fac   = factor(Year),
      Site_fac   = factor(Site_clean)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Cover_Prop))
  
  model_formula <- bf(
    Cover_Prop ~ Year_fac + (1 | Site_fac)
  )
  
  fit <- brm(
    formula = model_formula,
    data = df_sub,
    family = family,
    backend = "cmdstanr",
    chains = chains,
    cores = cores,
    iter = iter,
    warmup = warmup,
    control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95, max_treedepth = 12),
    seed = 42
  )
  
  return(fit)
}


# =============================================================================
# 3. DIAGNOSTICS & MODEL FIT EVALUATION
# =============================================================================

# evaluate_model_fit <- function(model_fit) {
#   message("\n--- Running Model Diagnostics & PPC ---")
#   
#   # Print summary table (Rhat, ESS)
#   fit_summary <- summary(model_fit)
#   print(fit_summary)
#   
#   # Posterior Predictive Checks
#   p1 <- pp_check(model_fit, ndraws = 50) + 
#     ggtitle("PPC: Observed vs Simulated Density")
#   
#   p2 <- pp_check(model_fit, type = "stat_grouped", group = "Year_fac", stat = "mean") +
#     ggtitle("PPC: Grouped Mean Cover by Survey Year")
#   
#   print(p1)
#   print(p2)
#   
#   # Leave-One-Out Cross-Validation
#   message("\n--- Computing LOO-CV (Pareto k Diagnostics) ---")
#   loo_res <- loo(model_fit, save_psis = TRUE)
#   print(loo_res)
#   
#   plot(loo_res, main = "PSIS-LOO Pareto k Diagnostics")
#   
#   return(loo_res)
# }
evaluate_model_fit <- function(model_fit, category_name = "Benthic Category") {
  message(paste0("\n--- Running Model Diagnostics & PPC: ", category_name, " ---"))
  
  # Print summary table (Rhat, ESS)
  fit_summary <- summary(model_fit)
  print(fit_summary)
  
  # Posterior Predictive Checks
  p1 <- pp_check(model_fit, ndraws = 50) #+ 
    #ggtitle(paste0("PPC: Observed vs Simulated Density — ", category_name))
  
  p2 <- pp_check(model_fit, type = "stat_grouped", group = "Year_fac", stat = "mean") #+
    #ggtitle(paste0("PPC: Grouped Mean Cover by Survey Year — ", category_name))
  
  print(p1)
  print(p2)
  
  # Leave-One-Out Cross-Validation
  message("\n--- Computing LOO-CV (Pareto k Diagnostics) ---")
  loo_res <- loo(model_fit, save_psis = TRUE)
  print(loo_res)
  
  plot(loo_res, main = paste0())#"PSIS-LOO Pareto k Diagnostics — ", category_name))
  
  return(loo_res)
}

# =============================================================================
# 4. POSTERIOR COVER EXTRACTION & TRAJECTORY PLOTTING
# =============================================================================

# Extract Mean/Median Cover (%) & 95% CIs per Year
get_year_posterior_summary <- function(model_fit, target_years) {
  tibble(Year = target_years) %>%
    mutate(Year_fac = factor(Year)) %>%
    add_epred_draws(model_fit, re_formula = NA) %>%
    mutate(Cover_Pct = .epred * 100) %>%
    group_by(Year) %>%
    summarise(
      Mean_Cover_Pct = round(mean(Cover_Pct), 2),
      Median_Cover   = round(median(Cover_Pct), 2),
      Lower_95_CI    = round(quantile(Cover_Pct, 0.025), 2),
      Upper_95_CI    = round(quantile(Cover_Pct, 0.975), 2)
    )
}

# Plot Trajectory Across Years
# plot_year_trajectory <- function(model_fit, category_name, target_years, fill_color = "darkseagreen3") {
#   tibble(Year = target_years) %>%
#     mutate(Year_fac = factor(Year)) %>%

#     labs(
#       title = paste0(category_name),
#       x = "Survey Year",
#       y = "Substrate Cover (%)"
#     ) +
#     theme_minimal(base_size = 14)+
#   theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
# }
plot_year_trajectory <- function(model_fit, category_name, target_years, fill_color = "darkseagreen3") {
  tibble(Year = target_years) %>%
    mutate(Year_fac = factor(Year)) %>%
    add_epred_draws(model_fit, re_formula = NA) %>%
    mutate(Cover_Pct = .epred * 100) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = Year_fac, y = Cover_Pct)) +
    stat_eye(fill = fill_color, alpha = 0.8, .width = c(0.66, 0.95)) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, NA),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))
    ) +
    labs(
      title = category_name,
      x = "Survey Year",
      y = "Substrate Cover (%)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(4, "pt"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
}

# =============================================================================
# 5. POST-HOC PAIRWISE CONTRASTS (emmeans)
# =============================================================================

run_posthoc_contrasts <- function(model_fit, category_name) {
  message(paste0("\n========================================================"))
  message(paste0(" POST-HOC PAIRWISE CONTRASTS: ", category_name))
  message(paste0("========================================================\n"))
  
  # Marginal Means on Response Scale (%)
  emm_year <- emmeans(
    model_fit, 
    ~ Year_fac, 
    type = "response",
    re_formula = NA
  )
  
  message("--- Marginal Posterior Means per Year (% Cover) ---")
  print(summary(emm_year))
  
  # Pairwise Contrasts
  year_pairs <- pairs(emm_year, reverse = TRUE)
  
  message("\n--- Pairwise Year Comparisons (Posterior Odds Ratios) ---")
  print(summary(year_pairs))
  
  # Tidy Difference Summary
  contrast_draws <- gather_emmeans_draws(year_pairs) %>%
    group_by(contrast) %>%
    summarise(
      Mean_Diff    = round(mean(.value), 4),
      Median_Diff  = round(median(.value), 4),
      Lower_95_CI  = round(quantile(.value, 0.025), 4),
      Upper_95_CI  = round(quantile(.value, 0.975), 4),
      Prob_Greater = round(mean(.value > 0), 4),
      Sig_Shift    = ifelse(sign(Lower_95_CI) == sign(Upper_95_CI), "YES", "NO")
    )
  
  message("\n--- Tidy Posterior Difference Summary ---")
  print(contrast_draws)
  
  return(list(
    emm = emm_year,
    pairs = year_pairs,
    summary_table = contrast_draws
  ))
}


# =============================================================================
# 6. COMPLETE WORKFLOW EXECUTION
# =============================================================================

# Step 1: Fit Model
fit_turf_algae_year <- run_benthic_bayes_year_glmm(
  data = bayes_benthic_df,
  target_category = "Turf Algae",
  family = zero_inflated_beta(),
  cores = 4
)

# Step 2: Evaluate Model Fit Diagnostics (PPC & LOO)
loo_turf_algae_year <- evaluate_model_fit(fit_turf_algae_year, "Turf Algae")

# Step 3: Extract Posterior Cover (%) & Generate Trajectory Plot
turf_cover_summary <- get_year_posterior_summary(fit_turf_algae_year, target_years)
print(turf_cover_summary)

p_turf <- plot_year_trajectory(fit_turf_algae_year, "Turf Algae", target_years)
print(p_turf)

# Step 4: Run Post-Hoc Pairwise Contrasts
turf_posthoc <- run_posthoc_contrasts(fit_turf_algae_year, "Turf Algae")

# Correct: extract the summary_table data frame from the list first
turf_thesis_contrast_table <- turf_posthoc$summary_table %>%
  mutate(
    `Median Diff [95% CI]` = sprintf("%.2f [%.2f, %.2f]", Median_Diff, Lower_95_CI, Upper_95_CI),
    `Mean Diff` = sprintf("%.2f", Mean_Diff),
    `Significant Shift` = ifelse(Sig_Shift == "YES", "Yes", "No (Stable)")
  ) %>%
  select(contrast, `Median Diff [95% CI]`, `Mean Diff`, Prob_Greater, `Significant Shift`)

# Print table
knitr::kable(
  turf_thesis_contrast_table, 
  format = "markdown", 
  caption = "Pairwise Contrasts for Algal Turfs (Post-Hoc GLMM Estimates)"
)
# Save to CSV file
write_csv(turf_thesis_contrast_table, "turf_pairwise_contrasts_summary.csv")
```

```{r}
plot_year_trajectory <- function(model_fit, category_name, target_years, fill_color = "darkseagreen3") {
  tibble(Year = target_years) %>%
    mutate(Year_fac = factor(Year)) %>%
    add_epred_draws(model_fit, re_formula = NA) %>%
    mutate(Cover_Pct = .epred * 100) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = Year_fac, y = Cover_Pct)) +
    stat_eye(
      fill = fill_color, 
      alpha = 0.8, 
      .width = c(0.66, 0.95),
      position = position_nudge(x = 0.111)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, NA),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))
    ) +
    labs(
      title = category_name,
      x = "Survey Year",
      y = "Substrate Cover (%)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(4, "pt"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
}
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 10
#| out-width: "100%"
```
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(tidybayes)
library(ggdist)

# 1. Define and filter custom disturbances and cyclone dates within 2016–2025
custom_disturbances <- as.Date(c("2020-02-01", "2021-03-15", "2025-02-01"))
custom_disturbances <- custom_disturbances[
  custom_disturbances >= as.Date("2016-01-01") & 
    custom_disturbances <= as.Date("2025-12-31")
]

cyclone_dates <- if (exists("jangamo_cyclones_summary") && "First_Impact" %in% names(jangamo_cyclones_summary)) {
  as.Date(jangamo_cyclones_summary$First_Impact)
} else {
  as.Date(character(0))
}

cyclone_dates <- cyclone_dates[
  cyclone_dates >= as.Date("2016-01-01") & 
    cyclone_dates <= as.Date("2025-12-31")
]

# 2. Plotting function updated to accept separate cyclone and custom disturbance dates
plot_year_trajectory <- function(model_fit, category_name, target_years, fill_color = "darkseagreen3", cyclone_dates = as.Date(character(0)), custom_dates = as.Date(character(0))) {
  
  # Helper function to map calendar dates to discrete factor axis positions (1, 2, 3, 4...)
  date_to_coord <- function(dt) {
    if(is.na(dt)) return(NA)
    d <- as.Date(dt)
    yr <- as.numeric(format(d, "%Y"))
    mo <- as.numeric(format(d, "%m"))
    dy <- as.numeric(format(d, "%d"))
    dec_yr <- yr + (mo - 1)/12 + (dy - 1)/365.25
    
    for(i in seq_along(target_years)) {
      if(i < length(target_years)) {
        start_yr <- target_years[i]
        end_yr <- target_years[i+1]
        if(dec_yr >= start_yr && dec_yr <= end_yr) {
          return(i + (dec_yr - start_yr) / (end_yr - start_yr))
        }
      }
    }
    if(dec_yr < target_years[1]) {
      return(1 + (dec_yr - target_years[1]) / 3)
    } else {
      return(length(target_years) + (dec_yr - tail(target_years, 1)) / 3)
    }
  }
  
  x_intercepts_cyclones <- sapply(cyclone_dates, date_to_coord)
  x_intercepts_custom <- sapply(custom_dates, date_to_coord)
  
  tibble(Year = target_years) %>%
    mutate(Year_fac = factor(Year)) %>%
    add_epred_draws(model_fit, re_formula = NA) %>%
    mutate(Cover_Pct = .epred * 100) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = Year_fac, y = Cover_Pct)) +
    # Cyclonic events in blue
    geom_vline(xintercept = x_intercepts_cyclones, color = "blue", linewidth = 0.4, alpha = 0.7, na.rm = TRUE) +
    # Custom disturbances in red
    geom_vline(xintercept = x_intercepts_custom, color = "red", linewidth = 0.4, alpha = 0.7, na.rm = TRUE) +
    stat_eye(
      fill = fill_color, 
      alpha = 0.8, 
      .width = c(0.66, 0.95),
      position = position_nudge(x = 0.15) # Nudge violins 4 months right
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, NA),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0.8, 4.6), clip = "off") +
    labs(
      title = category_name,
      x = "Survey Year",
      y = "Substrate Cover (%)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(4, "pt"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
}

# 3. Generate individual plots passing both cyclone and custom dates separately
p_cca <- plot_year_trajectory(fit_cca_year, "Crustose Coralline Algae", c(2016, 2019, 2022, 2025), "lightcoral", cyclone_dates, custom_disturbances)
p_hc  <- plot_year_trajectory(fit_hard_coral_year, "Hard Coral", c(2016, 2019, 2022, 2025), "darkgoldenrod2", cyclone_dates, custom_disturbances)
p_mal <- plot_year_trajectory(fit_mal_year, "Macroalgae", c(2016, 2019, 2022, 2025), "forestgreen", cyclone_dates, custom_disturbances)
p_sc  <- plot_year_trajectory(fit_soft_coral_year, "Soft Coral", c(2016, 2019, 2022, 2025), "lightseagreen", cyclone_dates, custom_disturbances)
p_sponge <- plot_year_trajectory(fit_sponge_year, "Sponge", c(2016, 2019, 2022, 2025), "cornflowerblue", cyclone_dates, custom_disturbances)
p_turf <- plot_year_trajectory(fit_turf_algae_year, "Turf Algae", c(2016, 2019, 2022, 2025), "limegreen", cyclone_dates, custom_disturbances)
p_rock <- plot_year_trajectory(fit_rock_year, "Bare Rock", c(2016, 2019, 2022, 2025), "grey", cyclone_dates, custom_disturbances)

# 4. Combine using patchwork
master_posterior_plot <- wrap_plots(
  p_cca, p_hc, p_mal,
  p_sc, p_sponge, p_turf,
  p_rock,
  ncol = 3
) +
  plot_layout(
    axes = "collect", 
    guides = "collect"
  )

master_posterior_plot
```

code with PERMANOVA

```{r}
library(vegan)
library(tidyverse)

# Define your main benthic functional categories
main_categories <- c("Hard Coral", "Soft Coral", "Turf Algae", "Macroalgae", "Crustose Coralline Algae", "Sponge", "Rock")

# =============================================================================
# 1. PREPARE THE STANDARDIZED COMMUNITY WIDE MATRIX
# =============================================================================
prepare_community_data <- function(data, categories) {
  data %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = all_of(categories),
      names_to = "Category",
      values_to = "Cover_Pct"
    ) %>%
    group_by(Dive_ID, Site_clean, Year, Category) %>%
    summarise(Cover_Pct = mean(Cover_Pct, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = Category, 
      values_from = Cover_Pct, 
      values_fill = 0
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Year_fac = factor(Year),
      Site_fac = factor(Site_clean)
    )
}

permanova_glmm_data <- prepare_community_data(bayes_benthic_df, main_categories)
comm_matrix <- permanova_glmm_data %>% select(all_of(main_categories))


# =============================================================================
# 2. GLOBAL PERMANOVA MODEL (Omnibus Test)
# =============================================================================
run_global_permanova <- function(comm_mat, meta_data) {
  message("\n>>> Running Global PERMANOVA Model")
  
  global_res <- adonis2(
    comm_mat ~ Year_fac + Site_fac,
    data = meta_data,
    permutations = 999,
    method = "bray"
  )
  
  print(global_res)
  
  # Format and save for appendix
  global_table <- as.data.frame(global_res) %>%
    rownames_to_column(var = "Source") %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 4)))
  
  write_csv(global_table, "permanova_global_model_summary.csv")
  message(">>> Saved global PERMANOVA summary to 'permanova_global_model_summary.csv'")
  
  return(global_res)
}

global_fit <- run_global_permanova(comm_matrix, permanova_glmm_data)


# =============================================================================
# 3. PAIRWISE PERMANOVAS (With Corrected Df Extraction & BH Correction)
# =============================================================================
run_pairwise_permanova_with_df <- function(meta_data, categories) {
  message("\n>>> Running Pairwise PERMANOVAs Across Survey Years (with Df)")
  
  years <- sort(unique(meta_data$Year))
  year_pairs <- combn(years, 2, simplify = FALSE)
  
  pairwise_results <- map_dfr(year_pairs, function(p) {
    yr1 <- p[1]
    yr2 <- p[2]
    
    sub_data <- meta_data %>% filter(Year %in% c(yr1, yr2))
    sub_comm <- sub_data %>% select(all_of(categories))
    
    res <- adonis2(
      sub_comm ~ Year_fac + Site_fac, 
      data = sub_data, 
      permutations = 999, 
      method = "bray"
    )
    
    # Explicitly extract Df for Year_fac by row name (guarantees a value of 1)
    target_row <- which(rownames(res) == "Year_fac")
    model_df <- ifelse(length(target_row) > 0, res$Df[target_row], 1)
    
    tibble(
      Comparison = paste0(yr1, " vs ", yr2),
      `Df` = model_df,  # Will now correctly show 1 for every row
      `R-Squared` = round(res$R2[1], 4),
      `Pseudo-F` = round(res$`F`[1], 4),
      `P-Value` = res$`Pr(>F)`[1]
    )
  })
  
  # Apply Benjamini-Hochberg (BH) correction
  pairwise_results <- pairwise_results %>%
    mutate(
      `Adj P-Value` = p.adjust(`P-Value`, method = "BH"),
      `P-Value` = ifelse(`P-Value` < 0.001, "< 0.001", as.character(round(`P-Value`, 4))),
      `Adj P-Value` = ifelse(`Adj P-Value` < 0.001, "< 0.001", as.character(round(`Adj P-Value`, 4)))
    )
  
  write_csv(pairwise_results, "permanova_pairwise_with_df_summary.csv")
  message(">>> Saved pairwise PERMANOVA summary to 'permanova_pairwise_with_df_summary.csv'")
  
  return(pairwise_results)
}

# Run it
pairwise_perm_table <- run_pairwise_permanova_with_df(permanova_glmm_data, main_categories)
print(knitr::kable(pairwise_perm_table, format = "markdown", caption = "Pairwise Community PERMANOVA Comparisons Between Years"))


# =============================================================================
# 4. HOMOGENEITY OF MULTIVARIATE DISPERSIONS (betadisper / PERMDISP)
# =============================================================================
run_permanova_dispersion <- function(comm_mat, meta_data) {
  message("\n>>> Running Multivariate Homogeneity of Dispersions (betadisper)")
  
  comm_dist <- vegdist(comm_mat, method = "bray")
  mod_disp <- betadisper(comm_dist, meta_data$Year_fac)
  
  # 1. ANOVA Table
  disp_anova <- anova(mod_disp)
  print(disp_anova)
  
  disp_table <- as.data.frame(disp_anova) %>%
    rownames_to_column(var = "Source") %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 4)))
  
  write_csv(disp_table, "permanova_dispersion_summary.csv")
  message(">>> Saved dispersion ANOVA summary to 'permanova_dispersion_summary.csv'")
  
  # 2. Tukey HSD Post-Hoc Table
  disp_hsd <- TukeyHSD(mod_disp)
  print(disp_hsd)
  
  disp_hsd_df <- as.data.frame(disp_hsd$group) %>%
    rownames_to_column(var = "Comparison") %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 4)))
  
  write_csv(disp_hsd_df, "permanova_dispersion_tukey_summary.csv")
  message(">>> Saved dispersion Tukey HSD summary to 'permanova_dispersion_tukey_summary.csv'")
  
  return(list(model = mod_disp, anova = disp_table, hsd = disp_hsd_df))
}

# Run it
dispersion_results <- run_permanova_dispersion(comm_matrix, permanova_glmm_data)
```
